content.text:
Build succeeded. Now restart wrangler — your `dev:cf` script runs `node build-worker.mjs && wrangler dev` so kill the running dev process and run `bun run dev:cf` again. Wrangler does **not** rebundle `dist/worker.js` automatically because we pass `--no-bundle`.

The new bundle now contains all the plugin routes (`/:pluginId`, `/:pluginId/dashboard`, etc). After restart, those endpoints should return 200.

Note for future: editing CF worker source while `wrangler dev` is running won't pick up the change — you need to re-run `node build-worker.mjs` (or restart `dev:cf`) to regenerate `dist/worker.js`. If this becomes annoying, I can wire `concurrently` to run esbuild in `--watch` mode alongside wrangler, but only if you want that.
